_doc: Thanksgiving preview ship list (same format as halloween/ship.json; seasons/README.md 'How to add a season'). ship-art.py --seasons ships it: titles -> art-title-thanksgiving-<key> (width 1080), walls -> art-wall-thanksgiving-<page>[-wide] (v2 set, opaque, JPEG on iOS), cast -> art-thanksgiving-<id> (320 square; o2 = cast/o2.png, never o2-v2; the nine -alt1 duplicates are NOT shipped), props -> art-thanksgiving-prop-<name> (256 square; all ten ship, the registry props slot lists them and the day-title pair rotates through them), extras -> the name given (scene fit = the base scene size, stage = full-bleed original, art-dress-tag-thanksgiving = the Dressing Room season tag at 444 wide, art-btn-thanksgiving-<name> = six blank candy button skins at 640 wide, no consumer slot yet). The achievement badges art-ach-harvest_feast / art-ach-tune_simple_gifts ship from badges/ach (ACH_DIR) like art-ach-spooky_season. The registry stays ready:false until the founder approves. Not shipped (no app slot yet, same as Halloween's): dailies-alt1, happy-thanksgiving(-alt1), label-give-thanks, label-gobble-gobble, thanksgiving, page-unlimited titles; badge-gobble, badge-harvest-streak, streak-flame-leaf, streak-shield-pie, tile-theme-pie, podium-thanksgiving, home-host-o1/w (docs/review/thanksgiving-extras-1016.md). Home banner = scenes/compose-thanksgiving-banner.py (cast + props composite; the Home stage card only draws with a season banner). The dress tab icon is the pumpkin-pie prop (the drawn extras/dress-tab-thanksgiving.png is an empty banner plaque, not an icon). 10-16 TIME OF DAY: walls ship per time as art-wall-<id>-<page>-<morning|day|evening>[-wide] from walls/wall-<page>-<tod>[-wide].webp (make-thanksgiving-walls-tod.py; night = the base wall); the stage ships per time from ../time-of-day/stage/chatgpt/ (night = art-celebration-stage-thanksgiving).
